english.title: Operator of premises other than slaughterhouse fail to ensure field lairage has proper facilities and in good condition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the business operator in respect of premises, other than a slaughterhouse, used for the killing of animals, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), failed to ensure that a field lairage

(A)_[which was without natural shelter or shade and was used during adverse weather conditions, had appropriate protection against such conditions for any animal using it]_
(B)_[was maintained in such condition as to ensure that no animal was subjected to any physical, chemical or other health hazard]_
(C)_[where necessary, had suitable equipment for tethering animals]_
(D)_[had adequate lighting available to enable the animals to be thoroughly inspected at any time]_
(E)_[was provided with drinking facilities and, if necessary, with racks, mangers or other equipment adequate in number and size for the watering and feeding of all animals confined in the field lairage, fixed where practicable, and constructed and placed so that they were easily accessible to all the animals, could readily be filled and could not readily be fouled]_

in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(1)(d) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 7 of Schedule 2 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
